subject.title: fix(cron): do not set delivery mode to announce when disabling best-effort on payload edits

question: Should this PR intentionally stop `--no-best-effort-deliver` plus payload edits from forcing `delivery.mode="announce"`?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but it changes behavior for existing cron edit automation that may have depended on the false flag plus payload edits as an implicit announce-mode update.

options.title: Accept the semantic fix
options.body: Land the PR with the current tests and proof, accepting that the false flag preserves the stored delivery mode instead of forcing announce.

options.title: Require old compatibility
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that preserves the previous implicit announce behavior unless a separate explicit opt-out is added.

options.title: Pause for cron delivery owner
options.body: Hold the PR until the cron delivery owner decides whether this compatibility change is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept the semantic fix
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the current tests and proof, accepting that the false flag preserves the stored delivery mode instead of forcing announce.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and the remaining blocker is maintainer merge-risk acceptance rather than a contributor code repair.
